lines.en: What happened when the snake charmer began to play jazz?
lines.zh: 耍蛇人开始演奏爵士乐时发生了什么？

lines.en: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of old Delhi,
lines.zh: 我们在老德里的一处市场走了很长一段路之后，

lines.en: we stopped at a square to have a rest.
lines.zh: 在一个广场停下来休息。

lines.en: After a time, we noticed a snake charmer with
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，我们注意到广场的另一边有位耍蛇人，

lines.en: two large baskets at the other side of the square,
so we went to have a look at him.
As soon as he saw us,
he picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins and opened one of the baskets.
lines.zh: 便拿起一根盖满硬币的长笛，打开了一个篮子。

lines.en: When he began to play a tune,
we had our first glimpse of the snake.
lines.zh: 我们第一次瞥见了那条蛇。

lines.en: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe.
lines.zh: 它从篮子里钻出来，开始跟着长笛的动作舞动。

lines.en: We were very much surprised when the snake charmer
lines.zh: 当耍蛇人突然开始演奏爵士乐和现代流行歌曲时，

lines.en: suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs.
The snake, however, continued to 'dance' slowly.
lines.zh: 然而，那条蛇却继续缓慢地“跳舞”。

lines.en: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!
lines.zh: 它显然分辨不出印度音乐和爵士乐的区别！
